author: WPB7
summary: The book's session handoff: the d6e9ff05 pointer, the alpha.1 and editorial states, and the long 709-page campaign record (Phases A-G, 145 items) with verification status. It is almost entirely book-process history. Its few technical corrections are already on the site at 009d40f5: base-loop presentation, ToColumnMajor, and the ReadColor fix. Surviving drift in CNA's own README and packet headers was recorded as issue candidates.

concepts.section: What was done in that campaign
concepts.text: The live base-loop contract: overrides call base Update/Draw, and presentation happens once, in GraphicsDeviceManager::EndDraw; the README's pattern of presenting inside Draw was stale.
tokens: A Present() inside Draw() presents every frame twice
concepts.note: The site teaches the corrected program; CNA's README still shows the stale pattern (issue candidate WPB7-i001).

concepts.section: What was done in that campaign
concepts.text: Math conventions: matrix products apply the left operand first, depth is [0,1], and Matrix::ToColumnMajor copies the sixteen fields rather than transposing.

concepts.section: What was done in that campaign
concepts.text: PacketWriter::Write(Color) writes four bytes, and at the audited pin PacketReader::ReadColor() read four floats, so a colour could not round-trip.
